scenarios.title: Create a new task

steps.intent: Type a unique task text into the todo input field and press enter.
steps.expectedObservation: The new task with text '{{uniqueTaskText}}' appears in the task list.

scenarios.verificationStrategy: Verify that the newly created task is visible in the task list.
relevantApplicationContext: textbox: What needs to be done? (active)
scenarios.expectedResult: The new task is successfully created and visible in the list.

scenarios.title: Mark a task complete

steps.intent: Create a new task with unique text '{{uniqueTaskText}}'.
steps.expectedObservation: The new task '{{uniqueTaskText}}' is visible in the task list.

steps.intent: Click the toggle checkbox associated with the task '{{uniqueTaskText}}'.
steps.expectedObservation: The task '{{uniqueTaskText}}' displays a completed state visually.

scenarios.verificationStrategy: Verify that checking the task's toggle reflects its completed state.
relevantApplicationContext: textbox: What needs to be done? (active)
scenarios.expectedResult: The task is marked as complete and shows its completed state.

scenarios.title: Filter active tasks

steps.intent: Create an active task with text '{{uniqueTaskText}}-ACTIVE' and a task to complete with text '{{uniqueTaskText}}-COMPLETED'.
steps.expectedObservation: Both tasks are visible in the list.
The task '{{uniqueTaskText}}-COMPLETED' shows a completed state while '{{uniqueTaskText}}-ACTIVE' remains unchecked.
The task list shows '{{uniqueTaskText}}-ACTIVE' and hides '{{uniqueTaskText}}-COMPLETED'.

scenarios.verificationStrategy: Verify that selecting the Active filter shows active tasks and hides completed tasks.
relevantApplicationContext: textbox: What needs to be done? (active)
scenarios.expectedResult: The active filter successfully displays only active tasks and hides completed ones.

scenarios.title: Remove a task

steps.intent: Create a new task with unique text '{{uniqueTaskText}}'.
steps.expectedObservation: The task '{{uniqueTaskText}}' is visible in the list.

steps.intent: Hover over the task '{{uniqueTaskText}}' and click the delete button.
steps.expectedObservation: The task '{{uniqueTaskText}}' is removed from the task list.

scenarios.verificationStrategy: Verify that removing a task makes it absent from the list.
relevantApplicationContext: textbox: What needs to be done? (active)
scenarios.expectedResult: The task is removed and no longer appears in the list.
